thought_path_snapshot: Generate all possible n-bit binary strings and attempt to build a valid color code using a backtracking algorithm. This approach allows exploring different permutations while ensuring the Hamming distance condition is met for each consecutive pair.

The issue arises because the backtracking approach does not guarantee finding a valid sequence due to the exhaustive nature of the search space. A more efficient approach would be to use a known algorithm for generating Gray codes and then modify it to ensure the Hamming distance between consecutive strings is within the given palette \( P \). This way, we can systematically generate a valid sequence if possible.
